heroText: A soft neutral fashion portfolio exploring texture, movement, layering, and material-focused design.
aboutHeading: Fashion design shaped by texture, materials, and mood.
aboutText: Designs by Brooke is an emerging fashion portfolio exploring the relationship between fabric, silhouette, color, and personal style. The work focuses on chiffon, lace, silk, soft neutral palettes, styling ideas, and visual storytelling.
portfolioIntro: This portfolio will showcase material studies, texture boards, fashion sketches, styling concepts, garment details, and finished creative projects.
journalIntro: Notes on materials, inspiration, process, styling ideas, and design direction.
contactText: For portfolio inquiries, collaborations, or questions, use the contact information below.
